title: U24 · Entity page
description: One page for any SISO thing: client, agency, industry, project, task, agent, machine, release. Same shape as Agent Base's EntityPage (project pages v2, apps/web/src/components/EntityPage.tsx) so a report page and the in-app page read alike. Hero (crumb, kicker, name, lede, tags, owner capsule, image stage) → joined stat bar (+ one activity chart) → bento of typed cards → one 'Not recorded yet' line. Every card carries its source in `info` (shown behind an i). Values that do not exist are left out and named in `missing`, never shown as 0.

hue.description: 0-360. Omit to hash hue_key (Agent Base projectHue: red/orange/amber are flipped away).

hue_key.description: The project name the hue is hashed from (same hash as the Halo faces).

state.description: Paints the hero's bottom rim: working = cyan, needs = amber, still = hue only.

kicker.description: Caps line in the hue, e.g. ['Industry','2 clients','1 live']

lede.description: One or two sentences. HTML allowed.

owner.description: The capsule. state drives the rim: working spins, needs-shaan breathes amber, else still.

sentence.description: HTML; <b class=w|a|d> colours working / needs / done.

stage.description: Right half of the hero. shots[0] is the front browser frame, shots[1] the one behind it. No shots → a hue field with `empty` saying why, or `icon` big.

icon.description: lucide name, shown big when there is no image

panel.description: Instead of a screenshot: a big glass readout (machine, release, task). {title, lines:[{k,v,tone}]}

chart.description: The stat bar's activity cell: day or week bars, `hot` index lit in the hue with its value in a white pill.

info.description: Where this card's data came from (shown on the i).

empty.description: One faint sentence saying what would fill the card.

work.description: type=work: {value, of, scope, segs:[{state,n}], items:[{id,title,state,href}], more:{n,label,href}}. state: building|tested|allocated|specced|todo|backlog|thought|built|gap|done

items.description: tiles: {name,line,img,icon,mono,hue,flag,warn,faces:[{project,status,name}],href} · feat: {icon,title,line,pill,tone,hue,href} · timeline: {at,text,em,hot} · people: {name,line,hue,href,right} · chips: {icon,label,em,href} · deliv: {at,title,line,pill,tone} · lines: HTML strings · checks: {text,done,em} · live: {url,code,line,dot,href}

missing.description: Fields with no source yet, one quiet line at the foot.
